property_summary: Calling OpenToThePublic reverts unless the caller is the owner.
Only the owner can change openToPublic via OpenToThePublic, so a non-owner calling OpenToThePublic should not change openToPublic in P but will change it in the mutant.

After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the openToPublic flag must remain unchanged; the bug violates this because removing the onlyOwner modifier lets anyone enable it, so the flag can be changed independently of AdjustBetAmounts.

After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the OpenToThePublic value must remain equal to the value it had before the call; the bug allows anyone to change it via the unprotected OpenToThePublic, so a non-owner can flip it and then AdjustBetAmounts will see the changed state.
